sources.title: What is Individualized Study?
sources.author: RIT School of Individualized Study
sources.content: RIT individualized study allows students whose interests do not fit neatly within a traditional degree to blend coursework around personal, professional, and career goals. Students work with academic advisors to identify interests and goals, select courses that build needed skills, connect with faculty, and map experiences such as co-op, internships, research, and study abroad. The result is an intentional plan of study rather than an unrelated collection of courses.
